title: Support bounded MSBuild MakeRelative in F# semantic project evaluation
outcome: F# semantic evaluation resolves RootDir patterns based on MSBuild MakeRelative without enabling arbitrary property functions.
acceptance: A nested F# project inheriting RootDir from Directory.Build.props resolves dependent imports and ProjectReference closure, with decisive semantic navigation assertions.
Release build, complete tests, external MCP gate, and website verification pass.
The bounded F# evaluator supports the exact allowlisted MSBuild MakeRelative form with MSBuildProjectDirectory and per-document MSBuildThisFileDirectory semantics.
Unsupported property functions, malformed arguments, and paths outside the workspace continue to fail closed with stable causes.

completion.summary: Delivered bounded, MSBuild-faithful MakeRelative support for F# semantic project evaluation, including project/current-document semantics, exact scalar behavior, fail-closed boundaries, capability/version contract, decisive navigation regressions, full green gates, and clean same-session dual review.
